about_the_game:
Experience a fresh new take on solitaire — in an epic adventure, where magic and strategy intertwine. Embark on a solitaire adventure to restore majestic castles to their dazzling glory, as you traverse over 1,000 spellbinding levels. Play timeless classic solitaire variants like Klondike and Spider, alongside wondrous new creations such as Lady Beth, Spire, and San Martino.

Help a cast of fantasy characters to overcome magical obstacles such as mischievous frogs, mystical barriers, and fiery blazes. Your quest will take you on a journey that includes Supersize, Challenge, Sliding and Match-2 levels.

Unlock powerful upgrades to enhance your journey, and choose from a variety of beautifully designed card decks. Tailor your adventure to your style with four unique modes: Normal, Hard, Relaxed, and Timed. Explore every level for hidden treasures and strive to achieve the legendary "Perfect" score.

Step into the adventure and let the cards lead you to triumph in the realm of Solitaire!

- Conquer over 1,000 captivating levels!

- Master 6 timeless Solitaire classics, including Klondike, Spider, and Freecell.

- Discover 18 unique Solitaire variations like Lady Beth and Spire, each with its own twist.

- Restore 10 stunning magical locations as you progress through your journey.

- Choose your challenge with 4 distinct game modes: Normal, Hard, Relaxed, and Timed.

- Take on supersize, challenge, sliding, match-2, and suit/rank bonus levels.

- Embark on quests to uncover hidden treasures and secrets.

- Customize your play with a selection of beautifully-crafted card decks.

- Unlock mesmerizing wallpapers to bring the magic to your desktop.

- Enjoy a symphony of enchanting tunes while you relax.
